hero.role: Full-stack engineer who proves it with *working* tools.
hero.lede: Malik Haider Ali builds scalable web platforms, AI-powered systems and autonomous workflows. Right now that means ESG and GHG reporting at Euthyna. Before it came a 27s → 3.5s speed-up at Piron Labs, creator payments at Webox Systems, MotionIQ, a phone-to-RabbitMQ sensor pipeline, and co-authorship of a Springer paper. Each claim on this page links to a demo that runs in the browser, or says plainly that none exists yet.
hero.plateTitle: Plate 1 · Core sample of a career

body: PUCIT in 2021, first repos in C and C++ in 2022, then Express APIs, React frontends and PostgreSQL schemas: student PERN projects that turned into production work.

Production came in three steps. At Webox Systems, VoodVR needed Stripe Connect payouts, subscriptions and real-time chat. At Piron Labs, Kickstart HQ needed speed, and response time fell from 27s to 3.5s. Since September 2025, Euthyna has needed AI for sustainability reporting: disclosure gap analysis, GHG calculations, climate risk and transition planning, and ownership structures turned into GHG boundaries.

Research runs alongside. MotionIQ streams phone sensors over Wi-Fi into RabbitMQ for activity-recognition data, and he is second author of HumCareADL in Springer's Multimedia Tools and Applications. Graphic design is the second discipline, which is why this portfolio is printed rather than templated.
Motto: code with purpose, build with passion, learn without limits.
